name: Engrave
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a quill pen)

EFFECT

Range 5 ft.
Area up to 10 square ft.
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell causes writing to be permanently carved into the designated surface, up to three lines of text. You can choose to make the writing look like elegant handwriting, crude lettering, or grand block letters. This spell functions only on materials with a hardness of 10 or less.
